I can't confirm whether Lumen offers nonprofit pricing, and I don't want to guess. Nonprofit and education pricing is handled by our billing team, so please email billing@lumen.io. To help them answer quickly, include:

- The email address on your Lumen account (or the one you plan to sign up with)
- Your organization's name and the nonprofit status you'd like them to check
- How many users you'd need, and whether you're looking at Starter or Pro

For reference, list prices are Starter at $12 per user per month ($120 per user per year billed annually) and Pro at $24 per user per month ($240 per user per year billed annually).
